description:
## Problem
Before #4340 LakeSail had no memory limit under Docker. #4340 adds a 4g default in docker/lakesail/docker-compose.yml for every engine and describes it as a limit mocker previously ignored. trunk-uat.yml and release-v2.yml set LAKESAIL_MEMORY_LIMIT to 12g, so CI certifies 12g while users get 4g, and nothing tests 4g at SF 1. The 12g shard has never run (the probe dispatch fails with HTTP 403). The guardrail on doris-tpcds-obt-results-capped-parallelism-20261111 says never to silently change UAT container limits.

## Change
Run LakeSail TPC-DS-OBT at SF 1 with the 4g default through `make heavy-run` and record peak memory and outcome. Then stop and bring the result to the owner. Changelog, spec wording, the compose default and CI values change only after the owner's choice.

## Decision gates
The owner chooses keep-4g-with-evidence, another value, or no default, after seeing the SF 1 result. CI and the user default must not differ without a stated reason the owner accepts.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the SF 1 run's bundle, mem trace and command are recorded; the compose default, both workflows, the provisioning table and the changelog state the same facts; a stage-2 CI run with the chosen value is linked, after #4340 merges develop (which carries the probe dispatch fix); memory headroom for 12g on ubuntu-latest is checked.

## Guardrails (owner, 2026-11-20)
Accepted by the owner in the choice dialog: the agent never posts a stand-in review, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. It arms with `make pr-arm` once per pull request and reports the result. Subagents are read-only. Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed. A blocked step stops this item; the agent moves to the next item and does not work around the block.
Review threads: the accepted text also said the agent never resolves a thread. Asked afterwards which rule applies, the owner chose: "The morning rule: I may resolve a thread once the bot has reviewed the new head and did not raise the finding again." ('I' is the agent.) So the agent pushes the fix and replies, and resolves a thread only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise that finding again.
